# glinet_usb (Resource)

Sets the USB port of the router to USB 3.0 or USB 2.0 (`system.get_usb3_disable` and `system.set_usb3_disable`). **Warning:** a change of `usb3_enabled` can disconnect the USB devices. The web UI shows a warning before the change, but the text of the warning is not in the web UI code, so the effect on the USB devices is not known. The router has one USB configuration, so use one instance of this resource. Only a router with a USB 3.0 port (`hardware_feature.usb3` of `system.get_info` is not empty) has this setting: on other routers, create and update fail and do not write to the router. The write is from the web UI code of firmware 4.8.3 and was not tested on a router. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The USB port works as USB 2.0.
resource "glinet_usb" "this" {
  usb3_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `usb3_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the USB port works as USB 3.0. When `false`, it works as USB 2.0. The router API has the opposite value `usb3_disable`. When the router gives no `usb3_disable`, the provider reads `false`, as the web UI does.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `usb`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "usb".
terraform import glinet_usb.this usb
```
